title: UI Bug: TileMap editor palette becomes unresponsive to touch/drag when editor language is set to Arabic
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.4.stable, 4.5.stable, 4.6.stable, and 4.7.dev (latest snapshots).
​Not reproducible in: English (LTR) language settings on the same versions

### System information

OS: Windows 10 (PC) and Android (Mobile - Honor X7b). ​Device: Laptop (Intel Celeron 1017U) and Mobile Phone. ​Input: Confirmed on both Mouse dragging and Touch gestures 

### Issue description

The TileMap editor palette becomes completely "frozen" regarding scrolling when the editor interface is switched to Arabic. This is not limited to touch devices; it also happens on Windows using a mouse.
​The Bug: In the Arabic (RTL) interface, you cannot scroll through the TileSet/Palette list. Dragging with the mouse or swiping with a finger does nothing.
​Observation: The UI seems to lose its scroll-container functionality once the layout is flipped to RTL.
​Comparison: Everything works perfectly when the language is English (LTR).

<!-- Failed to upload "XRecorder_Edited_20260510_01.mp4" -->

### Steps to reproduce


​Open any Godot project (4.4 or newer).
​Change Editor Language to Arabic and restart.
​Open the TileMap bottom panel.
​Attempt to scroll through the tiles using the Mouse wheel, Mouse click-and-drag, or Touch.
​Result: The list is stuck and does not move.

​N/A (Editor-wide UI regression. Can be reproduced in a clean project by toggling the Arabic language.)
